sentences.text:
=
 Dipak Paswan Son Of Gautam Paswan R/O Village- Guhjora Tola Choti  Kusum Ghat, P.S.- Chandan, Dist.- Banka  ... ... Petitioner  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Punita Devi W/O Dipak Paswan R/O Village- Harbhang, P.S.- Bandhuwa  Kuraba, Dist.- Banka  ... ...

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Brij Mohan Das, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Lakshmi Kant Sharma, A.P.P.

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 5 08-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
Nobody appears for opposite party no.2 in spite of valid service of notice on her.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/323/494/504 of the Indian Penal Code and sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that due to intervention of well wishers of both parties the dispute has been resolved and they have decided to live separately.
A copy of panchnama dated 26.6.2019 is annexed with the bail petition.
4. Considering the aforesaid facts, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82936 of 2023(5) dt.08-01-2025 six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Judicial Magistrate 1st class, Banka in Complaint Case No. 922 of 2019, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
